subject: MAP kickoff + Executive sponsor handshake — Helios Medical Q3 readiness
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helios-med.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP kickoff & exec sponsor intro (Helios Medical)

Hi Marissa / Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and observability tooling. We are preparing a pilot for Q3 and I want to get a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) started so we have clear milestones for procurement, security review, and performance validation.

Two quick asks to kick things off:
- Would you introduce your executive sponsor (VP/CTO level) so our CTO can align on escalation paths?
- Can your team propose a short MAP with evaluation gates for security, latency SLAs, and an acceptance test for integration with our on-prem EHR?

Proposed internal attendees from Helios: Sonia Alvarez (CTO, copied in), myself (VP Eng), product owner (TBD). We expect procurement starts the week of 7/5 and would like a production pilot by 8/20 if feasible.

I’d appreciate a short call next week to handshake on owners and risks — 30 min.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
VP Engineering | Helios Medical Systems
- phone: (415) 555-9124

[Attachment: Helios_Pilot_Summary.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helios-med.com>
Cc: Sonia Alvarez <sonia.alvarez@helios-med.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP kickoff & exec sponsor intro (Helios Medical)

Daniel — great to hear, glad the demo landed.

Short answers up front: yes — we’ll introduce a technical executive who will be the escalation/strategy partner for Helios, and we’ll send a draft MAP and evaluation plan by Tuesday.

Proposed exec sponsor: Rishi Malhotra (VP, Platform at Redwood Inference) — Rishi, can you confirm availability to be the executive lead on this one? He will be the contact if we need CTO-to-CTO escalation or contractual exceptions.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
- Week of 5/18: MAP kickoff and stakeholder roster (owners + SLAs)
- 6/1–6/21: Security & compliance questionnaire; SOC2 scoping; network requirements
- 7/5–7/16: Procurement & contract review; pricing/seat confirmation
- 7/19–8/2: Integration + performance runbook validation (staging)
- 8/9–8/20: Production pilot start and acceptance testing

I’ve attached a short MAP template and an evaluation checklist for perf/security so you can slot dates against your internal calendar.

Available times for a 30-min handshake next week: Tue 5/18 09:00–11:00 PT, Wed 5/19 14:00–16:00 PT. Let me know what works and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-2076

Attachments: Helios_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); Helios_EvalPlan.md (text/markdown)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP kickoff & exec sponsor intro (Helios Medical)

Marissa — I’m on board to be the exec sponsor for Helios. High-level notes for the team:

- Scope and escalation: I’ll own CT0-level escalation and be the sign-off for any SLA exceptions. For day-to-day technical questions, Sean should be the primary contact.
- Risk areas to flag early: EHR network isolation (we’ll need a short network topology and encryption confirmation), and quantization/precision testing for clinical inference workloads.
- Success metrics I care about: demonstrable 95th percentile latency under your peak payload, audited logs for access/retention, and a clean SOC2 evidence review.

Sean — please draft a one-page runbook for the staging performance validation and post it to the shared Drive link below before Wed. I’ll review and provide executive comments.

Thanks — R

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Platform | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP kickoff & exec sponsor intro (Helios Medical)

Thanks Marissa and team — this is helpful and aligned with our internal timeline. A couple of clarifications from Helios:

- Procurement window: confirmed start 7/5, and we will have legal on the first redline by 7/12.
- Security gate: our InfoSec needs an initial SOC2 evidence package by 6/10. Can Redwood commit to the evidence timeline?
- Quarterly outcomes: our CTO wants the pilot to demonstrate both (1) 95th percentile inference latency < 150ms for the standard EHR payload, and (2) an integration runbook that can be executed by our on-call ops team without Redwood support after cutover.

We’ll take the attached MAP and fill in Helios owners on the left column this week. If possible, let’s confirm a Tue 5/18 09:30 PT handshake — I’ll send the invite.

Best,
Sonia Alvarez
CTO | Helios Medical Systems
sonia.alvarez@helios-med.com
